answer_1.quote: Open-domain dialogue generation has received significant attention and has made notable advancements.

answer_2.quote: We consider three automatic evaluation metrics: BLEU, Distinct (DIST), and BLEURT.

answer_4.quote: We recruit five evaluators to manually judge 200 samples from each experiment in blind testing
answer_4.guideline: we set three metrics to comprehensively evaluate the generation quality: whether a response is readable (Read.), coherent (Coh.), and informative (Info.)
